scenarios.label: Direct AJBR and direct ICH rates
scenarios.description: Deterministic base case with 5.8% cost and 5% QALY discounting.

scenarios.label: Fraction-based AJBR
scenarios.description: AJBR is calculated as sampled ABR multiplied by the sampled joint-bleed fraction.

scenarios.label: Fraction-based ICH
scenarios.description: ICH rate is calculated as sampled ABR multiplied by the CNS/ICH proxy fraction.
scenarios.assumption: WBDR CNS fraction is used as a proxy for ICH.

scenarios.label: No mild-arthropathy decrement
scenarios.description: Mild arthropathy uses the pediatric anchor instead of the base derived utility.

scenarios.label: Less severe post-ICH mapping
scenarios.description: Persistent sequela uses the 0.78 mild/no-moderate disability utility cap.

scenarios.label: No discounting
scenarios.description: Both cost and QALY discount rates are set to zero.
